items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: And when Bunk first came to Tony's Bob-Amband in Lake Charles, Louisiana, well, that's where I met him that night.

ctx.x: Yeah. That's what I'd like to know, if you can tell about that while we're talking.

Well, I was- we were in Lake Charles at that time. I think that was in 1929. It was during the high water, we went to Lake Charles for the high water. It was in 27, I think. Oh, yes, there was a big flood in 27, I remember that. Yeah, in Iberia. Well, we was in Lake Charles, and we stayed over there. And then my mother came up there during the high water. See, I was up there a little before, living with my sister. Is your sister older than you? Yeah, she's older than me. And I quite, I used to go to dances and…
Yes. Was one of the called the Eagles, and then there was Ebon Thomas. No, that's not the one.
